description: Inspects PE/EXE/DLL (incl. .NET assemblies: runtime, types and methods), ELF, Mach-O (incl. universal), WebAssembly, Java .class, Android .dex, Lua/LuaJIT and Python bytecode: architecture, sections with entropy, imports/exports, PDB path, signing, overlay data (e.g. an embedded game pack), toolchain/engine hints and strings. detected names packers, protectors, installers, compilers and runtimes with the evidence for each (UPX, ASPack, MPRESS, Themida, VMProtect, Enigma, NSIS, Inno Setup, InstallShield, 7-Zip and WinRAR SFX, AutoIt, PyInstaller, Nuitka, Electron, Go, Rust, Delphi, MinGW, MSVC). capabilities says what the imports and strings point at (networking, cryptography, registry, starting processes, writing memory of other processes, debugger checks, screen capture, keyboard hooks, services), each with the imports behind it; an import is not proof of use and a packed binary hides its imports. PE: version info, manifest, icons and string tables from the resources, and the Rich header decoded to tool versions with its checksum checked. ELF: build-id, notes, interpreter, RUNPATH, DWARF producers. Mach-O: UUID, minimum OS and SDK, code signature and entitlement keys. WebAssembly: function names and body sizes, producers. Read-only: it does not unpack, decrypt or patch.

limit.description: Import and export names to return each (default 100).

match.description: Filter import/export names: substring, glob or /regex/i.

limit.description: Strings and resource entries to list (default 50).

strings.description: Also list the PE string tables (default false).
String options: min, limit, match, maxMB, raw.

maxMB.description: Scan this many MiB for strings (default 64).

raw.description: Include strings that look like byte noise (default false).

name: re_binary
title: Inspect an executable or bytecode
